description: Install or update Feature Discovery Workflow module config and help entries.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{inline values: skip prompts with provided values}

description: Open the BA front door: where the engagement stands, what is blocking it, what to do next.
outputs: spoken orientation, routing into any fdw skill

description: Turn a transcript, WBS, PRD or sales handoff into source-anchored features in the registry.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{path: one or more source documents}
outputs: feature folders with signal.md, registry entries, glossary terms

description: Check the registry and the feature folders still agree; each problem names its own fix.
Build and iterate a working prototype reusing the project's components, capturing behaviour as it goes.
Capture the prototype screens and produce the self-contained review document the client reads, answers and signs.
outputs: self-contained HTML packet with a built-in reply, screenshots, question map

description: Read every stakeholder's reply back in, close the questions they answered, surface disagreements, and mark the design approved on sign-off.
args: {feature-id}|{one reply file per person, or their words}
outputs: closed questions with the answering quote, filed replies, recorded sign-off

description: Write the per-feature spec from the approved design and its source evidence.
outputs: spec.md with provenance on every requirement

description: Mint stable requirement ids and mark the spec approved. Refuses while critical questions are open.
outputs: approved spec with stable requirement ids

description: Absorb a change raised against an already-approved spec and record how it was resolved.
Audit the feature set against itself: contradictions, overlaps, dependencies, terminology drift.
outputs: consistency report, regenerated questions rollup, graph edges

description: Report what would ship, what is not eligible, and how many blockers would travel into the PRD. Warns, never blocks.
outputs: pre-flight blocker report with the trend across phases

description: Bundle the phase's approved specs and drive bmad-prd to produce the phase PRD.
outputs: bundle manifest, BUNDLE.md, next-call agenda, phase PRD

description: Scope, open, close and report phases, carrying unfinished work forward.
outputs: phase records with carry-over and blocker counts, phase report

description: Render the engagement's arc across every phase: scope, what shipped, what slipped, blockers at handoff.
outputs: phase report with the blocker trend

description: Render the whole engagement: pipeline, blockers by owner, build order, phase progress.
